# EnterpriseGlue v0.40.10 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.40.9`.

## Highlights

- **frontend:** Loads public sign-in options while the organization finder checks the browser session.
- **starbase:** Uses the organization’s sign-in policy for project and engine member invitations.

## User and administrator impact

- Google and Microsoft sign-in buttons can appear as soon as the signed-out organization finder is ready.
- The app uses IBM Plex if it is ready for the initial render and keeps the system typeface for the visit if it is still loading.
- Dashboard setup actions appear as their data comes in and reflect what the signed-in account can do.
- Restricted project actions explain whom to ask for access.
- Project and engine invitation dialogs offer the delivery methods allowed by the current organization.

## API and integration compatibility

- OpenAPI documents both existing URL forms for invitation capability reads, creation and reissue.

## Database migrations

- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- The lookup contains public global provider labels. Session verification and provider validation remain unchanged.
- The authenticated tenant context determines the invitation scope. Existing role and sign-in policy checks still apply.

## Documentation

- Release notes describe the faster sign-in options and permission-aware setup guidance.
- Generated OpenAPI and the access governance reference document both supported URL forms.

## Rollback

- Redeploy the preceding compatible frontend image.
- Redeploy the preceding compatible backend image.

## Validation evidence

- Organization finder and dashboard tests cover preload reuse, retries and permission-aware progressive setup.
- Browser tests verify the initial IBM Plex choice and a stable system font through sign-in, organization selection and dashboard navigation with delayed fonts.
- Project and engine member route tests cover tenant-scoped capability and invitation inputs.
